notes: Channel evidence for review, not admitted family votes, total damage, independent-source certification or gameplay approval.
Cameo uses current resolved weapons, including reachable FireShrapnel descendants; reference rows use the selected comparison weapon. Reference secondary payload coverage can be incomplete.
Each channel and slot remains separate. Do not sum overlapping ground/Air, armor-split, elite, percentage or status channels.
Numbers are Versus multipliers in percent. 0 is explicit immunity for that channel; ? is unknown. An asterisk denotes a reviewed standard-engine default, not a declared value.
Armor names are preserved: DTA medium is not silently renamed to OpenRA light. Cross-game armor equivalence and actor armor placement need separate review.
DTA section overlays do not prove BaseSection or runtime preprocessing. Custom warheads do not inherit standard defaults in this report.
All armor columns are available below. Search filters actors; channel details retain conditions, target masks, routes and complete fields.
